{"script":"# create initialization script
cat > init_generate_logs.sh <<'EOF'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -e
mkdir -p log_files
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  lines=$((RANDOM % 6 + 5))
  outfile="log_files/log${i}.log"
  > "$outfile"
  for j in $(seq 1 "$lines"); do
    Y=2022
    M=$(printf "%02d" $((RANDOM % 12 + 1)))
    D=$(printf "%02d" $((RANDOM % 28 + 1)))
    h=$(printf "%02d" $((RANDOM % 24)))
    m=$(printf "%02d" $((RANDOM % 60)))
    s=$(printf "%02d" $((RANDOM % 60)))
    echo "$Y-$M-$D $h:$m:$s Connection established" >> "$outfile"
  done
done
EOF

chmod +x init_generate_logs.sh

# run the initialization script
./init_generate_logs.sh

# show the initialization script content
echo "--- init_generate_logs.sh content ---"
sed -n '1,200p' init_generate_logs.sh

echo "--- code snippet to count total lines (run from directory containing 'log_files') ---"
echo "wc -l log_files/*.log | tail -n1 | awk '{print \$1}'"

echo "--- total lines across all log files ---"
# compute total lines
wc -l log_files/*.log | tail -n1 | awk '{print $1}'
"}
